main_text.l: בלע Ch.&Syr.Absorbere,deglutire,devorare:De-
inde Syr. quoque est Vapulare,Percuti, quasi
Devorare plagas, Ithpeh. אתבלע Absorberi.
ܟܠܥܢ [?] Syr. Hamus ab Absorbendo dictus, Matth. 17.27.
ܟܠܥ [?] Syr. Sine, Absque, Praeter, Praeterquam.
בלין ܟܠ [?] Syr. Exoriri, Progerminare,
ܣܦ [?] Et eadem hora exortu est, Mar.4.5.
בלור בלוריתא Ch. Coma, Caesaries, בלוריתא
דמדינייתא Comam Midjanitidis, Num.25.6.in Jonath.
בלש Ch. Inquirere, Investigare, Scrutari, Per-
scrutari, perquirere. Pahel בלש Idem. Ithpeh.
אתבלש Perquiri, perveftigari. Ex Aphel Partic.plur.
מבלשין בתיא Scrutantes domos, Jesa.22.5.
בלושא Ch. Perscrutatio, Psalm.64.7.
בלושין Ch. Inquisitores, perveftigatores, explorato-
res, scrutatores.
במא , במתא Chal. Excelsum, locus excelsus, Idolis
aut cultui ipsorum consecratus. Hebr. במה.
Plur. במתא, במן.
במס במסא Ch. Excelsum, Altare idolorum, idem
cum praeced. Plural. במסין, במסי. Affine est Graec.
βωμος, & Hebr. במות. In Targ. Hierof. & Jon. legi-
tur saepius cum כמסי. Sed prave.
בנא , בנה Ch. & Syr. Aedificavit, Exstruxit. Ithpeh.
אתבני, Aedificari, regedificari, exstrui.

page.notes: Syriac and some Hebrew forms are only approximately reproduced and marked [?]; the vowel points and the Syriac glyphs of entries 2 to 4 are doubtful. The Greek word in the Affine entry is a best reading. The Hebrew after "cum" in the במס entry is uncertain. No margin notes on this page.
